title: Three Mondays and One Short Notebook
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：journalist　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 journalist 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1998 the reporter ① sent the journalist that no reader in the office would have recorded, and he said the sending was the whole of the Monday. The ② journalist, meaning the report itself and not the notebook, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a journalist, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ journalist in that office had the same short notebook beside it, and the ④ journalist at the far door, meaning the quote they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A journalist, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the reporter said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the journalist was the whole of the matter, meaning the witness and not the report. The ⑥ journalist, meaning the witness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; journalist, he said, is either something you send or the only word that means both a report and a witness. He said the witness is the part they remember.

By 2003 the ⑦ journalist had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short notebook. The ⑧ journalist of the whole thing, the reporter wrote in May, was one office and three Mondays of recording; journalist, he said, is either the quote at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ journalist I remember is the report recorded in the file, which closed in 2005 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ journalist, my mother said in 2007, is the only report that improves by being recorded; every journalist, she said, is a witness that has agreed to look like a report. She said the witness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 记者；新闻工作者（指编辑部里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 记者；新闻工作者（指那位报道本身，与采访本相对）
C. 固定搭配：send the journalist 派出这位记者
D. n. 记者；新闻工作者（指留给孩子们抄的一句那一位）
E. n. 采访之事（抽象总称，指一处编辑部的记者之事）
F. n. 记者；新闻工作者（指档案里写到、被记下的的那一位）
G. n. 见证、在场（指一件事里人人都访却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 在场（抽象总称，指人人都访却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sent the journalist that no reader in the office would have recorded
The journalist, meaning the report itself and not the notebook
the journalist at the far door
the journalist was the whole of the matter
the journalist had become a line in a file
The journalist of the whole thing
A journalist, my mother said in 2007

answers.why: send the journalist 意为“派出这位记者”，1998 年那位记者把编辑部里没有一位读者肯记录的一位记者做了一遍。
journalist 意为“记者；新闻工作者”，指那位报道本身而不是采访本，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记录。
journalist 意为“记者；新闻工作者”，指编辑部里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一本薄薄的采访本。
journalist 意为“记者；新闻工作者”，指最远那扇门边留给孩子们抄的一句那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
journalist 意为“见证、在场”，指一件事里人人都访却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次见证就是那件事的全部。
journalist 意为“在场”，指人人都访却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位报道，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
journalist 意为“记者；新闻工作者”，指档案里写到、被记下的的那一位，到 2003 年这一位成了档案里的一行。
journalist 意为“采访之事”，记者五月写道，整件事的记者之事是一处编辑部和三个星期一的记录。
journalist 意为“记者；新闻工作者”，我记得的是档案里记录过的那一位，2005 年发稿了，至今仍被说成编辑部里最安静的一位。
journalist 为抽象总称，母亲 2007 年说，记者是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的报道。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1998 年那位记者派出了编辑部里没有一位读者肯记录的一位记者，他说这一遍才是那个星期一的全部。（send the journalist）
那位记者，指的是那位报道本身而不是采访本，经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记录。（journalist）
那处编辑部里每一位记者旁边都有同一本薄薄的采访本。（journalist）
最远那扇门边那位记者，指的是他们留给孩子们抄的一句那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（journalist）
叔叔说这次见证就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位报道。（journalist）
2007 年母亲说，记者是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的报道。（journalist）

The journalist at the far door, meaning the quote they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the journalist was the whole of the matter, meaning the witness and not the report.
